title: Chat Prompt Templates
learning_objectives: Render a list of role-tagged messages into the single string a chat model reads
Fill prompt templates and detect missing or unused fields
Quote untrusted documents so they cannot close their own delimiters
entry_point: render_chat(messages, add_generation_prompt=True); parse_chat(text); fill_template(template, values); quote_document(doc)
hints: Validate while looping: `if m["role"] == "system" and i > 0: raise ValueError(...)`; build parts `f"<|{role}|>\n{content}<|end|>\n"`.
Parse by splitting on `"<|end|>\n"`; each non-empty chunk must start with `<|role|>\n` for a known role.
`fields = {name for _, name, _, _ in string.Formatter().parse(template) if name}`; compare with `set(values)`.

failure_feedback.advice:
Each message is `<|role|>
` + content + `<|end|>
`; add `<|assistant|>
` only with the generation prompt.
Reject empty lists, unknown roles and a system message after the first position.
Split on `<|end|>\n` and strip the role prefix from each chunk.
Find field names with `string.Formatter().parse`; report missing names sorted and unused keys.
Escape both `<document>` and `</document>` inside the document before wrapping it.
